kernel: fixed 2-period Si/SiO2 TMM, normal incidence, vacuum ambient/substrate
scope: numerical and synthesis spike, not a production kernel

variants.name: unrolled_ii1
variants.description: full layer unroll, outer loop II=1

variants.name: sequential_ii4
variants.description: layer chain not unrolled, outer loop II=4

notes: The float sin/cos implementation and fixed-point operators dominate resources.
II=1 uses 87% DSP and 81% LUT; relaxing to II=4 lowers DSP to 57% but raises LUT to 90%.
Neither variant leaves room to scale to 32 layers on this part.
Next options: fixed-point CORDIC/LUT trig, shared/time-multiplexed multipliers, reduced precision, a larger UltraScale+ part, or a GPU/surrogate path.
CPU remains the correct engine for interactive SME use; the FPGA case is batch throughput/power or embedded deployment.
